data.title: Pronouns — Starter · Lesson 10
data.subject: pronouns
data.lyrics:
¡Vamos!

[Hook]
City lights, city nights… Luces de la ciudad
Feel alive… Me siento vivo
We roam… Exploramos
Lost in time… Perdidos en el tiempo
This city's ours tonight.

[Verse]
Walking streets, feeling free…
Yo… I see the world in shades of you and me.
Your smile… Tu sonrisa lights the way.
Yours… Tuyo is the heart that leads the day.
Cross the square, past the old café…
Suyo… His laughter echoes through the alleyway.
This moment's ours… Nuestro destino to embrace.
Vuestro… Your stories fill this vibrant place.

[Hook]
City lights, city nights… Luces de la ciudad
Feel alive… Me siento vivo
We roam… Exploramos
Lost in time… Perdidos en el tiempo
This city's ours tonight.

[Verse]
Colors blend, dreams ascend…
Mía… My heart's a compass, it won't bend.
Past the fountain, where we danced…
Tuya… Your rhythm, your world, a second chance.
Street performers play their tune…
Suya… Her melody ends too soon.
But we keep moving… Nuestra historia to unfold.
